subject: Mythology
title: Valhalla: Hall of the Fallen
description: One-minute skill: Valhalla: Hall of the Fallen.

hook.text: Valhalla was a golden hall where warriors who died bravely in battle feasted with Odin every night.

buildup.text: The Valkyries — divine warrior women — flew over battlefields choosing the bravest of the slain.

discovery.text: Each day in Valhalla, the warriors fought and killed each other. Each night, they rose healed to feast again.

twist.text: It was not a reward. Odin was building an army. He needed every warrior for the final battle at Ragnarök.

climax.text: Viking warriors charged into battle fearlessly, hoping to die well enough to earn a seat in Valhalla.

punchline.text: Paradise was not rest. It was eternal training for the end.

quiz.question: Why was Odin collecting warriors in Valhalla?
options: To reward them for their bravery in life
To build an army for the final battle at Ragnarök
To protect Asgard from the frost giants
